name: Oxnard

queries.query: Oxnard California official parcel map GIS assessor parcel data ArcGIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the City of Oxnard GIS parcel layer and Ventura County GIS parcel layer. The City layer is a public ArcGIS Feature Layer with polygon geometry and APN field.

queries.language: English (local/native-language search; United States uses English)
queries.query: Oxnard California mapa parcelas oficial assessor GIS
queries.result: The local-language/variant discovery also resolved the first-party City of Oxnard maps/GIS pages and the City public-records page linking GIS and spatial data. No separate non-English local government cadastral service was found.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: City of Oxnard GIS Division, evidenced by the City-hosted ArcGIS service copyright and the City GIS/maps pages.
officialSourceAssessment.countyService: Ventura County GIS also publishes a parcel layer, but the retained sample uses the City of Oxnard-hosted service.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: A local public cadastral/parcel map service with polygon geometry and native APN identifiers was directly inspected; this supports registryFound=true. It does not establish legal title or owner records.

service.sourceCrs: WKID 102645 (NAD 1983 StatePlane California V FIPS 0405 Feet); returned sample requested as WKID 4326

sourceFieldMapping.OBJECTID: source object identifier (not retained as sample identity)

boundedAnonymousResponse.request: GET /arcgis/rest/services/BasemapLayers/MapServer/2/query with envelope [-119.183,34.187,-119.179,34.191] in EPSG:4326, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=OBJECTID,APN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: Public anonymous response returned 125 polygon features with APN and unchanged geometry transformed by the service to EPSG:4326. The envelope is a bounded neighborhood check, not citywide coverage.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point query was used to infer absence; the bounded envelope around the preserved WUP point returned 125 features.

safeFieldAllowlist: source layer and public service metadata

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City of Oxnard parcel map service; service extent covers the Oxnard area.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public layer metadata and a bounded anonymous parcel query were verified; citywide completeness and legal cadastral status were not independently established.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted.
A bounded map hit is not proof of citywide coverage or legal title.
Only three full parcel polygons are retained and their properties contain exactly one canonical native identity each.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The City of Oxnard first-party ArcGIS parcel service is publicly reachable and returned safe APN-plus-polygon features. Service completeness, update cadence, licensing, APN permanence, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
